[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Ann Glasgow was born in 1768. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-3991|James Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-763421|Jane Unknown]]. She passed away in 1832.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3991]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The published Larne monument identifies Ann with James and Jane in their continuing three-generation inscription. Adult James-3991 is the monument son, distinct from the older ropemaker.

Memorial-defined Ann→memorial adult James-3991.

Next useful test: Compare the monument and 1832 lease without assuming their subjects coincide.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3992 Armorial Sculptured Stones of the County Antrim, p. 47, Glasgow monument inscription.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


A possible identification concerns Anne Glasgow. An 1874 indenture traces James Glasgow’s 2 October 1779 Newtown of Larne lease to a 25 February 1832 renewal to Anne and Jane Glasgow.<ref>Inspected historical source; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS54-77Q4-H record].</ref> Original recital inspected. It establishes title succession, not stated descent; James and both women’s identities remain unresolved. The identification remains uncertain.
